groups.operation: Initialize or reset a gzip deflate stream, then generate its header with deflate.
groups.condition: Header generation follows initialization or a supported reset.
groups.capability: Keep gzhead null or valid for header generation.
groups.consequence: Header generation could use invalid gzhead state.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same gzhead state requirement across initialization and reset.

groups.operation: Emit caller supplied gzip header fields through deflate.
groups.condition: A gzip wrapped stream has a header installed with deflateSetHeader.
groups.capability: Reach gzip initialization, deflateSetHeader, and custom header generation.
groups.consequence: The harness cannot exercise custom gzip header output.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three describe the same custom header operation and missing setup path; their differing claims about build applicability do not change that target.

groups.operation: Emit the default gzip header through deflate.
groups.condition: Gzip window bits select a gzip wrapped stream with null gzhead.
groups.capability: Initialize the gzip wrapper and reach default header generation.
groups.consequence: The harness cannot exercise default gzip header output.
groups.equivalence_reason: Default header generation requires a different setup from caller supplied header generation.

groups.operation: Clear a previously installed custom gzip header with deflateResetKeep, then call deflate.
groups.condition: A customized gzip stream is reset before another compression.
groups.capability: Clear gzhead so the next stream emits the default gzip header.
groups.consequence: The harness cannot exercise the reset after customization sequence.
groups.equivalence_reason: This targets reset of an existing custom header, with a different condition and consequence from initial header generation or general gzhead validity.
